intro: Friend keeps you company. The paid pendant listens through your day and texts you like someone who was there. That is a real comfort, and it is also the whole product. When an email needs a reply, a meeting needs moving, or a task needs doing, Friend watches you do it. GAIA is the other half: an assistant that reads your inbox, manages your calendar, and follows through across your tools. Company is nice. Cleared plates are nicer.
